title: Add total cost input and price-per-liter display for fill-ups

requirements.summary: Capture total fuel cost in the Record Fill-Up UI and submit it with the existing fill-up fields (English UI text + validation + toast errors).
acceptanceCriteria: "Record Fill-Up" form includes a numeric input labeled "Total cost" and validates it as a non-negative number (required or optional).
On submit, the frontend sends the cost value to the backend together with odometer and fuel added, using the same unit conversion approach already used for odometer/fuel.
If the backend rejects the request, the existing toast-based error handling continues to show an English error message.

file_operations.description: Add a new "Total cost" numeric field to the Record Fill-Up dialog, including local state, disabled-state behavior consistent with existing fields, and submission payload including totalFuelCost. Use existing shadcn-ui form primitives (Input/Label/Button/Dialog) already used in this file. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Extend fill-up form validation to include total cost (non-negative number; align required/optional decision with the form behavior) and return an English validation message when invalid.
Extend the fill-up form-related types to include totalFuelCost (string in form data and/or number in entry type as appropriate) so the new input and submission payload are typed.
Update the add-fill-up mutation to accept totalFuelCost and pass it into the backend addFillUp call, while preserving the existing actor readiness checks and query invalidation flow.

requirements.summary: Compute and display Price per liter in the Fill-Up History list using total cost divided by liters, with sensible formatting and fallback when cost is missing.
acceptanceCriteria: Fill-up entries in the history list display a new field labeled "Price per liter" when total cost is available for that entry.
Displayed price per liter is computed as (totalCost / fuelAddedInLiters) and formatted to a readable fixed decimal format.
For fill-ups without a stored cost value, the UI does not break and shows an English fallback (e.g., "N/A") or hides the field consistently.

file_operations.description: Extend FillUpEntry to carry totalFuelCost (and optionally a derived pricePerLiter field) so the history list can render it without changing unrelated features.

When mapping backend FillUp records to FillUpEntry, include totalFuelCost when present and compute pricePerLiter as totalFuelCost / fuelAdded (liters). Handle missing/invalid/zero values safely so older fill-ups remain renderable (e.g., omit derived field when cost is absent).

Update the Fill-Up History rendering to show a new "Price per liter" field per entry when available, formatted with a fixed decimal precision, and a consistent English fallback (e.g., "N/A") when missing. Use existing shadcn-ui Card/Badge patterns already in the file. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
